source_boundary: Approved public residence listing and detail pages only; published StarRez URLs are navigation evidence and are never fetched.
missing_value_semantics: Missing source evidence stays unknown; it is not false, unavailable, ineligible, or zero.
collection_absence_semantics: For schema-required collection fields, an empty array means no source-backed members were captured; it is UNKNOWN for truth claims and must not be interpreted as an explicit negative.

entity_universe.discovery_rule: Discover residence detail links from the approved public listing and accept only exact HTTPS pages below /accommodation/our-residences/<slug> on study.anu.edu.au.
entity_universe.identity_rule: entity_id is the canonical residence URL slug and record_id is accommodation:residence:<entity_id>.
entity_universe.temporary_disappearance_rule: An observed count below 19 is suspicious and must preserve last-known-good data for investigation; disappearance is not immediate deletion evidence.

cross_repo_price_decision.current_effective_rule: Numeric max-price filtering is supported only when at least one explicit named room has an unambiguous published AUD weekly rate satisfying the threshold. Advertised-rate numeric filtering, sorting, ranking, affordability claims, and total-cost calculation remain unsupported.
cross_repo_price_decision.agreed_rule: A residence matches a numeric max-price constraint when at least one named room has an unambiguous published AUD weekly rate satisfying the threshold; the qualifying room, exact cost period, contract, inclusions, and other fees remain attached. Advertised 'from' wording remains display/comparison-only evidence.
cross_repo_price_decision.unknown_rule: A missing or ambiguous room rate is UNKNOWN, not NO_MATCH; any result set containing unevaluable records is incomplete rather than globally empty.
cross_repo_price_decision.ownership_rule: The scraper freezes source evidence and capability semantics; RAG applies only the agreed interpretation; the App displays the structured result and never parses price text itself.
cross_repo_price_decision.rag_alignment_status: Carmen confirmed the boundary and will update the Day 4 RAG implementation and tests.

advertised_rate.semantic_guard: Preserve qualifiers such as 'Rates from', A$, /wk, and the exact cost period; do not turn a starting rate into an every-room, availability, affordability, or total-cost claim.

evidence_requirements: rate was parsed only from the published Weekly Inclusive Tariff field
AUD currency is unambiguous from the published residence price context
exact published cost period is present

residence_result_semantics.MATCH: At least one evaluable named room satisfies the threshold; return the qualifying room evidence.
residence_result_semantics.NO_MATCH: Every published named room rate is evaluable and every one fails the threshold.
residence_result_semantics.UNKNOWN: No room proves MATCH and at least one published or expected room rate is missing or ambiguous.

rooms[].rate.semantic_guard: A qualifying rate remains attached to its room name, cost period, contract, inclusions, and other fees; it proves neither vacancy nor residence-wide affordability.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Exact source-backed category membership when present.

field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Inferring location from a residence name, contact block, or nearby text.
Synonym expansion or inferring catering from features or room prose.
Personal eligibility or guessed audience equivalence.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display or compare the exact advertised-rate wording with its source context.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Numeric normalization, total-cost calculation, cheapest ranking, or filling a missing advertised rate from a room rate.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Qualify displayed room and advertised rate evidence with the exact published period.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Assuming currentness, equivalence between periods, or an unstated contract interval.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Compare source-backed room objects and apply the agreed numeric max-price rule only to an explicit named room with an unambiguous published AUD weekly rate, while preserving the room's cost period, contract, inclusions, and other fees.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Flattening fields across rooms, filtering from advertised_rate or fee text, numeric price ranking, total-cost calculation, or detaching rates from cost period and contract wording.
Synonym expansion or treating an absent feature as false.
Deterministic filtering or extracting unstated attributes.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display exact published accessibility wording when present.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: A universal accessibility boolean or inference from generic features.
Application outcome, eligibility, vacancy, or availability inference.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Navigate to the exact published outbound application URL.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Fetching authenticated StarRez, deriving application status, or treating link presence as vacancy.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display exact published eligibility wording when present.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: A personal eligibility decision or inference from audience labels.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display published email, phone, location, and hours without filling missing subfields.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Availability, open-now status, or contact-detail synthesis.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Use only an explicit published vacancy statement; null means not established.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Inferring available, unavailable, or false from rates, rooms, application links, or missing text.

representative_cases.name: multiple room facts and complete contact subfields
single room facts and missing optional contact subfields
